$comment: Single machine-readable source of truth for the controlled-merge policy. Consumed by scripts/eif_merge_pr.py (the merge gate) and scripts/tests/test_merge_gate.py. Do not hardcode the required check contexts anywhere else - read them from here. The context names must match the job `name:` values in .github/workflows/ci.yml exactly (that is what GitHub's statusCheckRollup reports). required_check_contexts, allow_no_checks, and knowledge_delta_required are the ONLY switches that can relax enforcement, and only by editing this file - eif_merge_pr.py has no CLI flag that can override any of them.
required_check_contexts: Frontmatter and config schema validation (required by policy)
Vertical slice - init, index, search, locale, demo test (required by policy)
YAML and JSON Schema syntax check (required by policy)
